recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work to revive, remove, or further explain elementdefinition-selector should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack with FHIR-I review rather than by restoring the retired extension to core.
issue_request: FHIR-12641 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core request to add an ElementDefinition selector extension so each slice could carry a FHIRPath entrance criterion, with selector-only slicing potentially allowing an item to match multiple slices.
initial_application: The request was applied in svn revision 11179, preserved as git commit 3253654af7787e9b738b15f4618a2b9d02d56f7f, which reworked ElementDefinition.slicing.discriminator and added the selector extension row with the requested FHIRPath selection criteria and multiple-slice comment.
additional_context: Core later removed extension definitions from the R5 source in dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 while retaining the selector canonical OID in source/oids.ini. The current authoritative definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack and is retired/deprecated. FHIR-41758 and FHIR-I minutes confirm the later decision to deprecate elementdefinition-selector because tooling did not support it and the relevant FHIRPath is calculated automatically.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Restoring selector to core ElementDefinition or profiling text would conflict with later source ownership and deprecation decisions; extension-pack edits are outside this core reconciliation branch.

related_jiras.note: The same svn revision reworked discriminator into type/path, but that broader discriminator model is separate from the selector-extension audit.
The Extension Pack issue later deprecated elementdefinition-selector because it was unsupported and effectively superseded by tooling-calculated FHIRPath.
